battle.name: 五隴坂之戰
battle.brief: 武德七年八月，頡利、突利二可汗傾國南侵，連營直抵長安西北，李世民率兵拒守於幽州城西五隴阪：單騎馳詣虜陳責其背約，又於雨夜潛師逼近敵營，並說動突利請和親，突厥遂退。卡面科林斯青銅盔為希臘重裝步卒裝備，與本役相隔逾一千二百年，不在陣中；現場交戰者為唐制兜鍪、明光鎧、馬槊、胡弓與弩。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 本役的交戰雙方是唐與東突厥汗國。唐軍方面，總指揮為高祖李淵坐鎮京師、秦王李世民率行軍主力赴前線，指揮系統是行軍總管與行台長史之制：世民領左右十二衛大將軍，節制關中與隴右調發之兵，並有岐州刺史柴紹、綏州都督劉大俱、靈州都督楊師道等分道策應；京師宿衛由北衙禁軍與十二衛擔任，糧秣由關中倉府供應。突厥方面，汗庭由頡利可汗統轄，與突利可汗為兄弟，兩部合兵自陰山、山西方向南下，連營而來；營中以可汗牙帳為中樞，設夾畢特勒、葉護、特勒等官，分領本部騎兵，其兵以輕騎與甲騎混合，能自攜帳幕、肉酪乾糧，離營即戰，不必仰賴攻城器械。兩軍實力並非單一對單一：唐為遠道勞師，以步騎混編與城守器械補騎戰之短；突厥為傾國而出的騎兵集團，來去迅疾。是以五隴阪一役並非會戰，而是唐軍依托關中城防與雨季氣候，對突厥傾國騎兵的一次拒止與外交周旋。
countriesEn: The two sides in this engagement were the Tang and the Eastern Turkic Khaganate. On the Tang side, overall command remained with Gaozu Li Yuan in the capital while Prince of Qin Li Shimin led the field army; the command structure was that of the expeditionary commissioner (行軍總管) supported by a chief administrator (行台長史). Shimin held the commission of commander of the Left and Right Twelve Guards and controlled troops dispatched from Guanzhong and Longyou, with detached forces cooperating with him: Qizhou governor Chai Shao, Suozhou commander Liu Daju, and Lingzhou commander Yang Shidao. The interior guard of the capital was carried by the Northern Palace guard and the Twelve Guards, and grain came from the granaries of Guanzhong. On the Turkic side the khaganate was ruled by Qaghan Jieli, with his brother Qaghan Tuli as co-commander; the two hosts marched south out of the Yin mountains and Shanxi with their camps joined, the khan's tooth-tent forming the hub of command, and offices such as 夾畢特勒, 葉護 and 特勒 commanding their own divisions. The Turkic army was a mass of light and armoured cavalry that could carry its tents, meat and cheese with it and fight without any siege engines. The two sides were therefore not matched one to one: the Tang was a long-marched force mixing infantry and cavalry and short in horse-war provisions, while the Turks were a nationwide cavalry host that could strike and vanish. The Battle of Wulongpo was accordingly not a set-piece battle but a refusal of the Turkic invasion, fought with Guanzhong's fortifications and the rainy season as Tang weapons and settled largely by diplomacy.
people: 核心人物是秦王李世民。時年二十六歲，他以行軍總管身份統兵拒突厥，而數月之前方經楊文幹之變：慶州都督楊文幹舉兵反亂，事發後牽出太子建成，高祖一度許諾以世民為太子，繼而又改。此役之前，世民力諫不焚長安而徙都以避禍，謂請「系頡利之頸，致之闕下」，又以「不出十年，必定漠北」激勵建成。高祖既不欲與突厥血戰，又因子弟交讎，兵權分授三子：世民、元吉同出幽州道，而元吉懼戰，世民遂獨馳百騎至陣前。突厥一邊，頡利可汗統大軍、列陣五隴阪城下，面對單騎挑戰「笑而不應」，又疑突利與唐有謀而止其渡水；突利可汗為其弟，先期不應世民，繼而聽從利害之說，遣夾畢特勒阿史那思摩（頡利之從叔）見世民，請和親並自請結為兄弟。收束此役的另有數人：柴紹出杜陽谷抄擊，裴寂奉命使突厥，劉大俱在綏州要擊；世民幕府中的近臣房玄齡、杜如晦輩掌記室、參軍事，關中宿衛與京師留守則由高祖居中調度。
peopleEn: The central figure is Prince of Qin Li Shimin. At twenty-six years of age he commanded the field army against the Turks, and only months before he had been caught up in the Yang Wenggan affair: the Qizhou governor Yang Wenggan raised troops in revolt, and the disclosure of the conspiracy reached Crown Prince Li Jiancheng, so that Gaozu at one moment promised the succession to Shimin and then withdrew it. Before this campaign Shimin urged the court not to burn Chang'an and move the capital away from the Turkish threat, offering to "bind Jieli's neck and bring it to the imperial gate", and he goaded Jiancheng with the claim that within ten years the desert north would be settled. Gaozu did not want a pitched battle with the Turks, and with his sons at loggerheads the command of troops was split three ways: Shimin and Yuanji were both sent out on the Youzhou route, but Yuanji was too frightened to fight, so Shimin rode out alone with a hundred horsemen to the enemy line. On the Turkic side Qaghan Jieli led the main host and drew it up in array at Wulongpo below the city, meeting the single-rider challenge with a laugh and no answer, and then halted Shimin at the ditch when he suspected Tuli of plotting with the Tang. Qaghan Tuli, Jieli's brother, at first did not answer Shimin either, but afterwards accepted the argument of advantage and profit and sent the 夾畢特勒 A-shina Simo, Jieli's paternal uncle, to see Shimin with a proposal for a marriage alliance, and on his own initiative asked to become sworn brothers with him. Several others brought the campaign to a close: Chai Shao struck at Duyang valley, Pei Ji was sent as envoy to the Turks, and Liu Daju ambushed the invaders at Suozhou. Shimin took counsel with the close officers of his own staff, Fang Xuanling and Du Ruhui, who served as recorder and military aide, while the capital was held and the interior guard of Guanzhong was directed from the court by Gaozu himself.
kits: 卡面那件科林斯青銅盔鑄於公元前七世紀，是希臘重裝步兵的頭部防具：整片青銅罩住頭面，只留兩道狹窄目孔與鼻脊，視野幾近於無，設計前提正是「只能靠隊形活」。它與本役相隔逾一千二百年，並不出現在唐軍裝備序列中，此處只作對照：科林斯盔所代表的是以密閉集體防禦換取個人防護，而五隴阪一役的唐軍同樣不與突厥騎兵爭野戰消耗，轉而以城垣、陣列與器械維持防線。真正上陣的是唐制裝備：頭戴兜鍪，身披明光鎧、札甲，格鬥用佩刀（橫刀、格門刀）與長柄馬槊、長槊，射手用唐人稱胡弓的直臂弓及擘張弩，軍中分步射與馬射，陣前列大盾與拒馬；火器尚未出現，攻守全靠冷兵器與火箭、拒馬一類原始燃燒器材。突厥裝備則以皮裘、革甲為主，角弓配鳴鏑箭，佩馬刀與長矛，騎兵多不著重甲而恃馬速與群射。營具方面，突厥連營帳幕隨行，備肉酪乾糧，驟然轉掠而無須輜重車；唐軍關中久雨，糧運阻絕，士卒疲於征役，器械頓弊，正是此役真正的弱點所在。
kitsEn: The Corinthian bronze helmet on the card was cast in the seventh century BC as the headgear of the Greek heavy infantry: a single sheet of bronze covering the whole head and face, leaving only two narrow eye-slits and a nasal ridge, so that the field of view is almost nil. Its entire premise is that the wearer survives only by staying inside the formation. It postdates this campaign by more than twelve centuries and never entered the Tang order of battle; it appears here purely as a foil. What the Corinthian helmet stands for is defensive power bought at the cost of the individual, and the Tang at Wulongpo likewise refused to trade blows with Turkic cavalry in the open, holding a defensive line with walls, formations and equipment instead. What actually went to war was Tang kit: the 兜鍪 helm, the 明光鎧 and 札甲 lamellar and brigandine armour, sidearms such as the 橫刀 and 格門刀, and long-hafted 馬槊 and 長槊. Archers used the straight-armed bow the Tang called a Hu bow and the 擘張弩, the army distinguishing between foot archers and horse archers, with large shields and cheval-de-frise in front of the line. There were no firearms; defence and attack rested on cold steel and on crude burning devices such as fire-arrows and spiked barriers. Turkic equipment was leather and hide armour, composite bows with whistling arrows, sabres and long spears, and the horsemen for the most part rode without heavy armour, relying on horse speed and massed shooting. In the field the Turks carried tentage with the camp and ate meat and cheese dried into portable fare, so they could sweep across country without baggage trains. The Tang, by contrast, had prolonged rain in Guanzhong, grain convoys cut off, troops worn down by years of service, and equipment in poor repair. That, rather than any tactical blunder, was the real weakness of the day.
tactics: 唐軍戰術核心是「不示之以怯」與「以逸制勞」兩手。八月己卯，頡利帥萬餘騎奄至幽州城西，陳於五隴阪；世民謂元吉「今虜騎憑陵，不可示之以怯」，自請獨出，帥百騎馳詣虜陳，告以「國家與可汗和親，何為負約」，繼而挑以單騎獨鬥之約，迫頡利「笑而不應」；又遣騎告突利，以舊盟「有急相救」相責。頡利見世民輕出，又疑突利與唐有謀，遂止其渡溝水，軍稍卻。真正的機會在雨：關中久雨不止，世民謂諸將「虜所恃者弓矢耳，今積雨彌時，筋膠俱解，弓不可用，彼如飛鳥之折翼；吾屋居火食，刀槊犀利，以逸制勞，此而不乘，將復何待」，遂潛師夜出、冒雨疾進，突厥大驚。外交與奇襲並行：世民一面遣使說突利利害，促其聽命、遣使請和親、自請結兄弟，一面令柴紹出杜陽谷抄擊、劉大俱在綏州要擊、裴寂入朝議和，企圖把一次傾國來犯拆散為數處可收拾的小勝負。突厥則仍以多路游騎分擾原州、忻州、幷州、綏州、甘州，牽制唐軍，企圖以廣泛掠擾消耗關中，而不是求一決勝負。
tacticsEn: The core of the Tang method was to refuse to look afraid and to strike the enemy at his leisure. On the jih-mao day of the eighth month Jieli led more than ten thousand horsemen up to the west of Youzhou city and drew them up at Wulongpo. Shimin told Yuanji that the enemy's cavalry was riding roughshod over them and that they must not show weakness, offered to go out alone, and rode with a hundred horsemen straight to the Turkic line to tell them that the Tang had made a marriage alliance and why was the promise broken. He then challenged the khan to single combat, and Jieli laughed and did not answer; he also sent riders to Tuli, recalling the old oath that in extremity the one would come to the aid of the other. Jieli, seeing how lightly Shimin had come out and suspecting a plot between Tuli and the Tang, stopped him at the ditch and drew his line back a little. The real opportunity lay in the rain. The rain in Guanzhong had continued without let-up, and Shimin told his commanders that what the barbarians relied on was their bows, and that after so much rain the sinew and glue of the bowstrings were all slackened so that the bows could not be used, the enemy was like a bird with its wings broken, whereas we, under a roof, eating hot food, with sharp knives and long spears, had the advantage of ease over toil, and if they did not seize the moment now, what would they wait for? Thereupon he led his men out by night through the rain, and the Turks were badly alarmed. Diplomacy and surprise ran in parallel. Shimin sent men to lay the advantages and the dangers before Tuli, who assented, sent an envoy to ask for a marriage alliance and offered to become his sworn brother; at the same time Chai Shao was ordered to strike at Duyang valley, Liu Daju to intercept at Suozhou and Pei Ji to go to court to discuss peace. The aim was to break one national invasion into several small and manageable defeats. The Turks, for their part, continued to send raiding parties in many directions against Yuanzhou, Xinzhou, Bingzhou, Suozhou and Ganzhou, pinning down Tang forces in the hope of wearing out Guanzhong through widespread harassment rather than deciding the matter in one battle.
data: 可徵的數字有限，以下均有史據。時間：武德七年（624）八月己卯接戰，九月癸卯劉大俱破突厥於綏州，十月己巳突厥再寇甘州。兵力：突厥「舉國入寇」，連營南上，可汗親領的接戰騎兵記為「萬餘騎」；世民出陣時自稱「我直以此百騎相當耳」，即百騎上下。戰果：庚寅岐州刺史柴紹破突厥於杜陽谷；九月劉大俱擊破來犯之眾，獲特勒三人。城與地形：五隴阪在長安西北、幽州城西，即今陝西鳳翔一帶，是漢唐關中西北邊防線上距京師不遠的一處崗阪，控扼自西北來犯者必經之地；本卡經緯度取該地約略位置。外交與人事：壬申思摩入朝、賜爵和順王，丁酉遣裴寂使於突厥，此後頡利、突利之請婚、和親皆以此為契據。至於兩軍總兵員、陣亡數、俘虜數與攻城器械數量，《資治通鑑》《舊唐書》《新唐書》皆未記載，本卡不作推補，亦不引用後世小說與演義中的夸張數目。
dataEn: The figures that can be verified are few, and all of the following rest on the historical record. Timing: the clash took place on the jih-mao day of the eighth month of Wude seven (624); on the kuei-mao day of the ninth month Liu Daju defeated the Turks at Suozhou; on the chi-ssu day of the tenth month the Turks raided Ganzhou again. Strength: the Turks came with the whole nation, their camps joined as they moved south, and the cavalry the khan personally led into the engagement is recorded as more than ten thousand riders. Shimin, riding out to the enemy line, put his own force at about a hundred horsemen, saying that that was what he offered to match. Results: on the geng-yin day the Qizhou governor Chai Shao broke the Turkic force at Duyang valley; in the ninth month Liu Daju defeated the invading party and captured three tel (commander-bearers). Place and terrain: Wulongpo lay to the northwest of Chang'an, west of Youzhou city, in what is now the Fengxiang area of Shaanxi, a ridge on the northwestern defence line of Guanzhong not far from the capital, commanding the road by which invaders from the northwest had to come; the coordinates on this card follow that location approximately. Diplomacy and personnel: on the jen-shen day Simo was brought to court and granted the title Prince of Heshun, and on the ting-ssu day Pei Ji was sent as envoy to the Turks, a step on which the subsequent proposals of marriage and peace between the two khans rested. As for total numbers on either side, casualties, prisoners and counts of siege equipment, neither the Zizhi Tongjian nor the Old or New Tang histories record them; this card therefore adds no figures of its own, and quotes none from later novels and operas, where the numbers are exaggerated.
cause: 起因為東突厥在唐初未能以兵威制止的連年寇邊。頡利可汗自貞觀前夜即不斷南下，殺掠代州、朔州、原州、隴州、陰盤、幷州諸地，掠取子女玉帛；唐廷曾議焚長安而徙都以避之，秦王力諫乃止，說明朝廷對正面決戰缺乏把握，也說明突厥以劫掠為主要目標。唐初百廢待興，關中府庫空虛，又連年用兵於河北、山南，糧秣不繼，士卒疲敝，器械損耗；武德七年突厥趁唐廷內部因太子建成、秦王李世民、齊王李元吉之爭而內耗之際，傾國南下，正取其疲。於是高祖以「和」為主要方針，屢遣使往還、賂以財貨，唐廷則在「徙都避禍」與「出關迎戰」之間搖擺；世民所請者不是決戰，而是「乘其弓廢、志懈、兄弟將離之一隙」，把一次傾國入侵轉為外交與奇襲可以收束的局勢。史家又記，高祖晚年寵諸妃嬪，妃嬪受建成、元吉之賂而短世民，朝廷因此「信讒言、疏骨肉」，可說這場入侵之所以得以深入關中，與唐廷內部的分裂互為表裏。
causeEn: The cause lies in the unbroken raiding along the frontier by the Eastern Turks, which the early Tang had not been able to stop by force. Qaghan Jieli had been pushing south since the very eve of the reign, killing and plundering in Daizhou, Shuozhou, Yuanzhou, Longzhou, Yinpan and Bingzhou and carrying off women, children, silk and jade. The court had even proposed burning Chang'an and moving the capital away, and only Shimin's remonstrance stopped it, which shows how little confidence the court had in a pitched battle and equally that plunder, not territorial gain, was the Turkic objective. At the founding of the Tang the state was exhausted, the granaries of Guanzhong were empty, and troops were still being spent in Hebei and in the south of the mountains; grain did not keep up, the men were worn out and equipment was in poor repair. In the seventh year of Wude the Turks came down with the whole nation precisely in that state, taking advantage of the exhaustion at home produced by the rivalry among Crown Prince Jiancheng, Prince of Qin Shimin and Prince of Qi Yuanji. Gaozu's main line was therefore conciliation, with envoys sent and received and payments made; the court swung between moving the capital out of reach and riding out to meet the enemy. What Shimin asked for was not a decisive battle, but to seize the one opening in which the enemy bows would be useless, their resolve slack and the two khans about to fall out with one another, so as to convert a national invasion into a situation that diplomacy and a night attack could close. The historians also record that Gaozu in his later years favoured his consorts, who took bribes from Jiancheng and Yuanji and spoke ill of Shimin, so that the court came to trust slander and to grow cold towards its own sons; in this the depth of the Turkic penetration into Guanzhong and the internal division of the Tang court are two faces of the same thing.
impact: 此役的影響落在三層。第一是邊防與外交：突利自此與世民結為兄弟，頡利亦遣從叔思摩入朝、受封和順王，唐遣裴寂使突厥，換來數年間邊局緩和，然和約未能杜絕掠邊，同年秋冬突厥仍寇綏州、甘州，可見是緩衝而非終結。第二是唐廷內部：世民以單騎退敵、冒雨出奇，聲威大震，功名愈盛，而建成、元吉愈不安，兄弟爭儲至此更形激烈，最終推向武德九年六月玄武門之變；世民當時「不出十年，必定漠北」的話，也說明關中防禦的重心將由守轉攻。第三是戰史觀念：此役常被視為渭水之盟的前身與對照，同樣以「不戰而退敵」的智略見稱，同樣是唐初對突厥外交手腕的成型之作，而五隴阪之別處在於它有雨、有夜、有奇襲，把心理戰與戰術奇襲合為一體，被後世兵家視為「以逸制勞」「避實擊虛」的古典範例，也說明冷兵器時代的騎兵並非不可制，只要能讓其最倚重的武器失效，並在其內部製造離心。
impactEn: The effects of the engagement fall into three layers. First, frontier and diplomacy: Tuli from then on was a sworn brother of Shimin, Jieli too sent his uncle Simo to court, who was granted the title Prince of Heshun, and the Tang sent Pei Ji as envoy to the Turks, buying several years of easing on the frontier. The treaty did not end the raiding, however; the Turks were still raiding Suozhou and Ganzhou in the autumn and winter of the same year, so what was bought was a respite and not a settlement. Second, the Tang court itself. Shimin, who had turned back a national invasion with a hundred riders and a night march through the rain, became vastly more famous, and Jiancheng and Yuanji grew correspondingly more alarmed; the struggle over the succession sharpened and finally ran towards the Xuanwu Gate incident of the sixth month of the ninth year of Wude. His remark that within ten years the desert north would be settled also marks the moment when the defence of Guanzhong was to shift from waiting to attacking. Third, in the history of war this engagement is commonly treated as the prelude and parallel of the Treaty of the Wei River: it too is celebrated for defeating an enemy without a battle, and it too marks the shaping of Tang diplomatic technique towards the Turks. What distinguishes Wulongpo is that it combined rain, night and surprise, fusing psychological warfare with a tactical raid into a single whole. Later military writers read it as a classical model of striking at ease while the enemy labours and of avoiding the strong and hitting the weak, and as demonstration that cavalry in the age of cold steel could indeed be beaten, provided one could spoil the weapon it relied on most and breed dissension inside the enemy camp.
result: 結果是唐軍未作大規模會戰而退敵，唐廷以最小的野戰代價換得一次成功的邊防外交。八月己卯於五隴阪，世民責以背約、激其單鬥、斷其弓而雨夜出、遣使說突利，數路並施，頡利終不敢再進，突利反請結為兄弟，並遣夾畢特勒阿史那思摩入朝請和親；九月癸卯劉大俱破其於綏州、獲特勒三人，庚寅柴紹破之於杜陽谷。惟其後突厥仍寇甘州，入侵並未真正結束，兩汗的和約也只是延緩而非解決了北患；此役的直接成果，是唐廷在開國之初以一次成功的拒止贏得喘息之機，並把李世民推到更顯赫的位置上，為其後數年北伐突厥、終於貞觀年間平定東突厥，埋下政治與軍事上的雙重伏線。史家評價，多以為唐廷由此看清突厥騎兵並非不可制，但也指出唐廷在戰後仍以賂遣使為對待突厥之常策，掩盡了北伐之志，這一轉折要到貞觀初年才真正完成。
resultEn: The result was that the Tang turned back the invasion without a major pitched battle, buying a successful piece of frontier diplomacy at the smallest possible cost in open combat. On the jih-mao day of the eighth month, at Wulongpo, Shimin upbraided the khan for breaking the treaty, goaded him into single combat, disabled his bows and marched out by night in the rain, and sent men to work on Tuli, all at once; Jieli at last did not advance again, while Tuli offered instead to become a sworn brother and sent the 夾畢特勒 A-shina Simo to court to ask for a marriage alliance. On the kuei-mao day of the ninth month Liu Daju defeated the invaders at Suozhou and took three tel prisoner, and on the geng-yin day Chai Shao broke them at Duyang valley. The invasion, however, was not truly over, for the Turks raided Ganzhou afterwards, and the accord between the two khans delayed the northern problem rather than settling it. The immediate outcome of the campaign was that the Tang, at the very beginning of the dynasty, won a breathing space through a successful refusal, and that Li Shimin was raised to a far more eminent position, laying political and military groundwork for the campaigns against the Turks in the years to come and for the final destruction of the Eastern Turks in the Zhenguan era. Most historians judge that the Tang court came to see that Turkic cavalry was not invincible, but they also point out that the court's standing policy towards the Turks remained payment of tribute and the sending of envoys, which buried the intention of a northern campaign; that turn was not completed until the early Zhenguan years.
